flagged.title: Pip's Disillusionment
flagged.reason: The video presents an invented line attributed to the wrong speaker as a key quote ('You let me go on' attributed to Pip rather than Miss Havisham) and reverses the backstory of Miss Havisham's fortune by stating it came from Compeyson's fraud rather than Compeyson defrauding her.

mark_affecting.quote: Miss Havisham's wealth is deeply tainted anyway, since it partly comes from Compeyson's fraud.
In chapter 44, Pip looks at Miss Havisham and says, 'You let me go on.'

flagged.title: The Ending & Pip's Redemption
flagged.reason: The video presents the misquoted and misplaced line 'Joe had brought with him a simple dignity' as a direct quotation from the nursing scene, teaching an inaccurate quotation.

mark_affecting.quote: Joe had brought with him a simple dignity.

flagged.title: Character Analysis
flagged.reason: The video includes the fabricated quotation 'own colonist as shall be a gentleman', which would penalise GCSE English Literature students relying on it for direct textual evidence.

mark_affecting.quote: proudly declaring he will 'own colonist as shall be a gentleman.'
